description_en: Invoke Machine Translation Professional Edition to obtain translation results.
description_zh: 调用机器翻译专业版获取翻译结果
kebab_example: aliyun alimt translate --format-type text --target-language en --source-language zh --source-text '你好' --scene title --api-version 2018-10-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Translate

parameters.help_en: Format of the text to be translated: html (web page format; setting this parameter processes both the source and translated text as HTML) or text (plain text format; setting this parameter treats both the input source text and the translation result as plain text without any formatting)
parameters.help_zh: 翻译文本的格式，html（ 网页格式。设置此参数将对待翻译文本以及翻译后文本按照html格式进行处理）、text（文本格式。设置此参数将对传入待翻译文本以及翻译后结果不做文本格式处理，统一按纯文本格式处理
parameters.name: format_type

parameters.help_en: Target language. <props="china">Refer to language codes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215387.html)</ph></props><props="intl">Refer to language codes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/machine-translation/latest/machine-translation-language-code-list)</ph></props>
parameters.help_zh: 译文语言，<props="china">参考语言code (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215387.html)</ph></props><props="intl">参考语言code (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/machine-translation/latest/machine-translation-language-code-list)</ph></props>
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: Source language. <props="china">Refer to language codes (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215387.html)</ph></props><props="intl">Refer to language codes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/machine-translation/latest/machine-translation-language-code-list)</ph></props>
parameters.help_zh: 原文语言，<props="china">参考语言code (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215387.html)</ph></props><props="intl">参考语言code (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/machine-translation/latest/machine-translation-language-code-list)</ph></props>
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: Available values for the scenario parameter: Product title (title), Product description (description), Product communication (communication), Medical (medical), Social (social), Finance (finance)
parameters.help_zh: 场景可选取值：商品标题（title），商品描述（description），商品沟通（communication），医疗（medical），社交（social)，金融（finance）
parameters.name: scene

parameters.example: 早上我在家里吃了面包
parameters.name: context

DetectedLanguage.description_en: Source language code after language detection when the source language is set to auto
